instruction: Navigate to the FlightAware flight data API documentation.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the FlightXML API documentation page on FlightAware. Simple navigation task similar to original. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Single-step navigation task with evaluator checking correct end state (FlightXML API documentation URL)
Correct state extraction: Getter (active_tab_info with get_active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts active tab URL from Chrome accessibility tree
Correct metric logic: is_expected_active_tab correctly compares URLs using compare_urls() utility function
Correct expected value: URL https://www.flightaware.com/commercial/flightxml/ is the actual FlightAware API documentation page
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly expects rules dict directly as 'rule' parameter and accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'], matching framework behavior for expected.type='rule'
Runtime feasible: No complex state dependencies, straightforward URL verification without need for postconfig
